bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
test -d /mnt/g/GserverStorage
git fetch --no-tags origin 74f012f6074ae513190946d470cbb104961ce037
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 74f012f6074ae513190946d470cbb104961ce037
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,sys
sha="74f012f6074ae513190946d470cbb104961ce037"
for file in ("userbot_public_video_archive_all.py","userbot_public_video_activate_all.py"):
    dest=Path("scripts")/file
    content=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{sha}:scripts/{file}"])
    if dest.exists():
        if dest.is_symlink() or dest.read_bytes()!=content:
            raise RuntimeError(f"STAGED_FILE_CONFLICT:{file}")
    else:
        with dest.open("xb") as fh:fh.write(content)
        os.chmod(dest,0o644)
    compile(dest.read_text(),file,"exec")
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
from userbot_public_video_activate_all import compose_updates
updates=compose_updates(sha)
print("ALL_PUBLIC_CHANNEL_PREPARE=PASS")
print("PAGINATION_UPDATE_FILES="+",".join(p.name for p in updates))
PY
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
if systemctl --user list-units --all --no-legend 'gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service' | grep -q gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114;then echo ALL_JOB_ALREADY_REGISTERED;exit 77;fi
systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py --source-commit 74f012f6074ae513190946d470cbb104961ce037
echo ALL_PUBLIC_CHANNELS_JOB_LAUNCHED=YES
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result --no-pager
echo RESIDENT_PRESERVED=YES
